title: Far-Red (730nm) Photon Fraction Steering for Rapid Leaf Area Index Expansion without Stem Lodging
author: Dr. vmffkxhs2362
abstract: Far-red light (730nm) converts active phytochrome B ($P_{fr}$) into inactive $P_r$, triggering shade avoidance responses. We applied dynamic end-of-day (EOD) Far-Red pulses (15 μmol/m²/s for 20 minutes) during early vegetative stages of leafy greens. The EOD-FR treatment expanded total Leaf Area Index (LAI) by 35% within 10 days while maintaining stem breaking strength above structural collapse thresholds.
key_findings: EOD Far-Red treatment accelerated canopy closure by 4.2 days, shortening crop cycle time.
Specific Leaf Area (SLA) increased by 22.5%, maximizing light interception efficacy.
Phytochrome photo-equilibrium ($P_{fr}/P_{total}$) shifted from 0.82 to 0.38 during pulse treatment.
